그루톱 비오틴 10000Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 10000μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc, 680μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 10000μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc, 680μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 550mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (10000μg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 550mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 550mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 550mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 550mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (680μg / 550mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 550mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 밝은 노란 주황 점박이가 있는 흰 노랑색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron

    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)

    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

  • Pantothenic acid
